image_description: A small Blenheim spaniel standing in profile facing right on a beige floor. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, long feathered ears, and a docked tail. Behind the dog is a dark, textured background that appears to be a furry rug or blanket.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape shows a distinct dome and the muzzle is short with a visible stop, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is dark and round; the spacing appears appropriate for the breed, though resolution limits precise measurement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are clearly long, set low on the skull, and exhibit significant feathering/fringe.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern matches the Blenheim description perfectly with clear distinction between white and chestnut/red areas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture appears silky and straight. Feathering is visible on ears, chest, and hind legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body proportions are compact and the back length is short relative to height, fitting the 'cobby' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Front legs appear straight. Hindquarters show feathering. Bone structure looks fine/appropriate for a toy breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is short (docked) and held horizontally, aligned with the topline. Feathering is present.
This is a static image, so dynamic gait cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The dark background texture has a slightly repetitive, smudged appearance typical of AI-generated fur patterns, lacking distinct individual hairs.
Slight softness/blurring at the contact points with the floor, potentially indicating minor generation artifacts or depth-of-field simulation issues.

Verify structural correctness of limbs, tail docking, and ear placement.

Assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies.
